Manifest.Name: 卷帘门今日事件 Shutter Events
Manifest.Author: User
Manifest.Description: Today's events before opening; four or more events use clear pages with previous/next controls, while durations share the title line and larger font settings auto-fit down to the original 100% range. A snapshot of investigation progress and case amount is shown on closing. 开店前显示今日事件；4 条及以上事件自动分页并提供上一页/下一页；持续时间与事件标题同一行；字号调大放不下时自动回落到原 100% 范围；闭店时读取一次调查进度与涉案总金额，读档和应用设置时按需刷新；沿用原有设置，无新增权限。
